title: How financial factors shape household happiness in China’s aging population
core_idea: Investigates how financial factors—risk aversion, financial literacy, and household debt—mediate the relationship between a higher proportion of older household members and household happiness in China, using China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) data (2015, 2017, 2019) and ordered logistic regression models.
tldr: Aims to examine the role of risk attitudes, financial literacy, and household debt in shaping household happiness amid China's demographic aging, using repeated national survey data and ordered logistic analysis to uncover underlying mechanisms.
